# TASK: Musicians tab

<!-- Generated by sdk-web <taskPhase> "all" on 2026-11-02 from [root/ai/] specs. v1 = hard-coded static site. -->

## GOAL
Show the musicians the studio has worked with, each with their own profile page.

## DATABASE
None. /content/musicians.ts exports Musician[] (with nested credits). Start with 3 placeholder musicians clearly marked TODO for real data.

## UI
Components required:
- MusicianCard — photo, name, genre; links to /musicians/[slug]
- MusicianGrid — responsive grid (1 / 2 / 3 / 4 columns by breakpoint), empty state "No musicians yet"
- GenreFilter — optional chip filter by genre (client component, URL ?genre=)
- CreditList — title, year, work type, optional link
- MusicianLinks — website / Spotify / Instagram / YouTube icons

Pages affected:
- /app/musicians/page.tsx — grid
- /app/musicians/[slug]/page.tsx — profile (generateStaticParams, generateMetadata)

## VALIDATION (Zod)
Not needed. Slugs must be unique: add a dev-time assertion in /lib/content.ts.

## BACKEND
In /lib/content.ts:
- listMusicians(filter?: { genre?: string; featured?: boolean }) → Musician[]
- getMusicianBySlug(slug) → Musician | undefined
- getLineupForMusician(slug) → LineupSlot[]

## BEHAVIOR
1. Visitor opens Musicians tab and sees the grid
2. Optionally filters by genre
3. Clicks a musician and sees photo, bio, credits, links
4. If that musician is in the festival lineup, a "Playing at [festival]" badge links to /festival

## API ACTIONS
None.

## DONE WHEN
- [x] Grid and profile pages build statically for every musician
- [x] Unknown slug returns the 404 page
- [x] External links open in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer"
- [x] All images have alt text (musician name)

## NOTES
Real musician names, bios, photos and credits are needed from the studio before launch.
